scope: Explicit variable children in selected whole-group5005 diagnostic minima.

priority_selection.reason: Batch105 and the user prioritize whole-group minima containing explicit variable children while preserving conditional-rule boundaries.

assertions: Generator v22 emits versioned typed V2 minimum trees with fixed and explicitly declared zero/one-byte variable children. Missing/mismatched minima, optional field declarations, child counts above one, missing group opt-ins, empty trees, cycles and size/depth overflow remain rejected.

Variable-bearing groups with custom rules require diagnostic_minimum_rule equal to the rule identifier, including reviewed variable-bearing ancestors. Missing/stale/misplaced audits fail compilation. This is an explicit author review assertion, not proof of Go function semantics.

Only DCCA SubscriptionID, SCAP1 SubscriptionID and combined Address gain whole-group opt-ins. Existing DCCA UTF8 nonempty width1 is reused; SCAP1 and combined add explicit zero-octet declarations. Wire fields/rules/slices and application validation remain unchanged.

Consumer checks complete metadata, exact path/key/flags, child counts, duplicate sibling keys, type/width, and depth/count/field/frame/reply budgets before allocation. Leaf AVP Length excludes padding; group lengths include padded children. Owned minimum quotes contain no unrelated siblings or subscriber values.

Legacy fixed-only V1 remains supported and rejects typed records. Mixed-version chains and malformed V2 fail closed without V1 or legacy-placeholder fallback. Present empty groups keep actual missing-child evidence.

Twelve TCP/TLS ordinary/emergency leaf cases verify three bindings, exact reply bytes/envelopes, held charges, no invalid delivery, subsequent valid requests and retirement. Ten negative network cases preserve combined subscription count, SCAP1 eleven parameters, conditional recipient, unreviewed SMS and default-close boundaries.

External generation exercises six primitive kinds in a nested mixed tree and a second repeated parent, with no internal import and no optional-child inference. Existing external leaf/fixed-group tests remain covered.

Public signatures/layouts and ops9 unchanged; all eleven digests and Bundle fingerprints change. Fifteen finite fuzz targets, dual-module full checks, pressure and separately sampled benchmarks pass. README, historical benchmark, immutable tags, pure Go and no persistence remain unchanged.
